lokele: Imi Paulo, Botomomu wa Masiya Yesu ko la lisangi lia Mungu la Timoteo etungani yasu,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ 1:1 Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

lokele: ende ebüchomu ende Masiya la bitungani yasu la lilendelu nda bokenge wa Kolose; booto end’ino la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango wasu.
english: to the saints and faithful brothers 1:2 in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Totofaekefa Mungu kelekele ako Sango wa Yesu Masiya Ngɛnɛ wasu, ani atosombokol’iso osombokoel’ino,
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

lokele: eoka tosoka mboli ya lilendelu lianu ndolendelo Masiya Yesu la losamɔ loanu ndosamaka ebüchomu batotina, loasɔ loa iɛli esisüchomo eoka yanu nda Use.
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

lokele: Wokakä nde oso loasɔ loa iɛli-si nda lioi lia wewe wa Mboli Ilau,
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

lokele: eyaiyelak’ino kwa nda wenda bototina imɔ, mboli-bi bisoota tuma la bisokondaka kwa asokelak’imɔ yao sisi yanu ko nda lise eliokak’ino la elialuwak’ino litina lia booto wa Mungu la wewe.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

lokele: Waekesomoko imɔ ani ko la Epafula, bokuwani lasu oyasamomu la oyale bosungi wa lotimbana wa Masiya ndosung’ino nda lifa liami,
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your 1:7 our behalf,

lokele: la oyasoluwes’iso losamɔ loanu lowachani la Bolimo.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

lokele: Eokao, ko nda lise eliaokak’iso ongoma, totimache ndosomboel’ino la ndömbel’ino mbo otumesomoko la liluwani lia lisangi liande la wɛlï bototina la lilembeeli lia Bolimo;
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

lokele: mbo oyaleke la boyaeli wengana nda baiso ba Ngɛnɛ wasu la boomales’Inde, ani bosoota tuma twa bekeeli bilau bitotina l’ani bosokonda ndoluwaka Mungu.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

lokele: Bowangemeke la bofoka bototi ko la isosha sha tala yande la likɔkɔmɛlɛ la bofiili amamwito la bootaota,
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

lokele: ani otofaka kelekele ende Mungu Sango oyasof’iso isosha shosangola botiko w’ebüchomu la Masiya nda eyaelo ya löwa. Boyaeli wa Yesu Masiya Bouwesi wasu
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

lokele: Mungu asɔɔnɔkɔl’iso nda isosha sha lilima la asofangola eyaelo yasu ndot’iso nda Bɔkɔta wa Wana wande oyasamomu lande,
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

lokele: ko lande ako Wana wande, tosoendolomo la tosomɛsɛlɔmɔ batwanelo basu.
english: in whom we have our redemption, 1:14 the forgiveness of our sins.

lokele: Ale bɔfɔnɔ ebosɔɛnɛlɛ wa Mungu oyaitɔɛnɛlɛ, Oyaotomu oso wa wenda bototina ewakelomoko;
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

lokele: eoka ko loasɔ loande bitotina fɛɛ yakelomoko, la nda Use la ono se, la ebisɔɛnɛlɛ l’ebitiɛnɛlɛ, ango këka ya bɛkɔta, ango bakakalesi, ango bakomyi, ango tososha, bitotina fɛɛ yakelomoko ko lande la eoka yande.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

lokele: Inde angɛnɛ nd’ayalaka oso wa bitotina la bitotina bisoundakana ngo ko lande.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

lokele: La Inde angɛnɛ ende Botö wa bindo eko Etanda, Oyaotomoko liasi, oso wa batotina ebatɛmwaka nda liwa, Botoli oso mbo ayeke tii ewa oso wa yaatotina fɛɛ.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

lokele: Eoka liaaka nde likomyi lioengana mbo tososha tototina toyalaka ngo ko lande,
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

lokele: la mbo aotwaneseke yaatotina lande angɛnɛ ko lande ako Masiya, asotinya ngɛla ya lokele ko la bakila ba lieka liande, ndootwanesa yaatotina, ango eya se, ango eya Use.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

lokele: La ino, wasiamaka sia la Mungu, wiyanaka lande nda baenyeli banu ko la bekeeli ibe,
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

lokele: kongo ko kwani asootwanes’ino ko la bindo ya boto nda liwa liande ndoemes’ino oso wande ani osüchomo, l’ani ososaesomo, angwɛnɛ ango litwanelo,
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

lokele: ambo ani akakɔkɔmɛk’ino nda lilendelu, angoeyaeyak’imɔ, angosokwasokwak’imɔ nda iɛli sha Mboli iïau eyokak’ino la ebisotomo boeki ende yaatotina eyakelomoko ose ya Use, la imi Paulo isoya bokuwi wa Mboli-ao. Bomusi ebotokaka Botomomu wa Yesu Masiya
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

lokele: Isoomala to nda bemusi ebisokelaka’mi ino l’ani asɔɔlɔlɔ’mi bemusi ya Masiya ebisoomelo nda bindo yami angɛnɛ loasɔ loa bindo yande, eko Etanda.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

lokele: Yafomoko isosha shosungaka likuwa lia Etanda ko la Mungu ndokuwel’ino mbo iisoelek’ino lioi litotina fɛɛ lia Mungu,
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

lokele: liko lioi eliaisomökö oso ende bato ko miaka wike la fɛtɔ wike, nde kwani nda mbile-ye, lisoisoelomo ebüchomu lande.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

lokele: Mungu losanga ndoluwes’iyo wike wa tala ya njasɔ-bi ebisoisolomo ende bato ba wenda, la lioi lina lile mbo— Masiya kowatema lanu, ambo ende tuka ya iɛli sha tala ena.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

lokele: Ende Inde kongo oyatonangokoela iso onangoel’Inde, oimaka boto la boto, la ndoekekesa boto la boto la wɛlï bototina, litina mbo toemeseke boto la boto oso wande ko boto oyasɔɔlwa ende Masiya oyawatemani lande.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

lokele: Ko la litina-li itokelaka likuwa la bonui ani itofumbaka ko la bofoka ona ebotofumbekes’Inde ofumbesa’mi.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

lokele: Ilɛmbi nde mbo ino boluweke ani atokelaka’mi likuwa lia efembi finɛ eoka yanu la eoka ya eba Laodikiya l’ebamɔi ebakɛni bɔmbɔ wami angɛnɛ,
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

lokele: mbo betema yau bifumbesomoko ani baɛowatemana la losamɔ, mbo bayaleke la wike wa liluwi liokɔkɔmɔ nda lilembeeli lia mbiso ya Mungu, ambo Masiya.
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

lokele: Bendanda bitotina ya wɛlï la liluwani biisamani nde ko ende Inde.
english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

lokele: Isoonga lanu ongoma mbo boto atalimbak’ino ndoimela efinole ko la baoi ba bɔlɛtɛlɛtɛ,
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

lokele: eoka ango itiyale lanu nda bindo, ambo yende lanu nda bolimo, la isoomala ani atɔɛnɛ’mi likɔmɔnyi lianu la bɔkɔkɔmu wa lilendelu elisolendel’ino Masiya.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

lokele: Kwa aelak’ino Masiya Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu, ongoma kɛndɛnɛkɛ lande nda betema yanu,
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

lokele: ani osokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ kwa isandu, ani ososwomo se suu kwa ndakɔ, ani osokɔkɔmɛlɛ nda lilendelu liande, kwa aekesomoko ino la liineli lia kelekele ya likama. Beimo loasɔ loa liekesi lia njasɔ ebitiengane
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

lokele: Lambaka la wɛlï mbo boto atalimbak’ino ndoind’ino ko la baoi ba wɛli wa bato, ebale ko lilimbi eliti la litina; liekesi-li lisotutaka ko toongo twa bato angɛnɛ, la etwa belimo ya oso ya wenda-bo, la liti liekesi lia Masiya.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

lokele: Eoka ambɔlɛ wa litina lia isosha sha Mungu bosoyala nda bindo ya Masiya kwa asoyala boto nda ndakɔ yande,
english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

lokele: la asoyalak’ino lande, osotumesomo fuu lande oyale Botö wa likomyi la isosha sitotina.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

lokele: Asoyalak’ino lande, watinyomoko totombe etotitinyomo ko la besamba ya balomboki, kangä ko la liwatoli lia bindo ya bolomboki nda itombe sha Masiya;
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

lokele: waombomoko lande nda lolufiomo loanu, la nda loao imɔ watɛmɔlɔmɔkɔ amamwito lande ko la lilendelu nda bofoka wa Mungu oyatɛmɔlɔkɔ Inde nda liwa.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

lokele: La ino, ayalak’ino ko belyo nda loasɔ loa batongwi banu la sunga ya bindo yanu, osofomo liwawi liyai amamwito la Masiya, ani asomɛsɛl’iso batongwi basu batotina;
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

lokele: asalaka lokasa loa bolima wasu loasɔ loa bakakanelo ebatefolak’iso, aombolaka loao tungi, la awachaka loao la likɔ̈kɔ nda lieka.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

lokele: Inde lotombola bakomyi la tososha, la Inde lochambola bao chambo la Inde loomalaka fololo eoka yolong’iyo ko la lieka. Boimo eoka ya bieka la bilämbɔ la saki
english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

lokele: Boto angɔmɔi atafëk’ino se eoka yola la yomwa yeka la eoka ya lilämbɔ ango elia tandole ango elia yenga;
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

lokele: bitotina-bi yende ko bɛfɔnɔ ya bilimi ya njasɔ ebikayeke, kongo ko bindo angɛnɛ bisoomana la Masiya.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

lokele: Boto angɔmɔi atakomy’ino ndotinjak’ino ndoikamela bakitomo se la liɔndwi se oso wau, boto wa bɔfɔnɔ-bo atolitesa saki ebisɔɛn’inde, atowaka bɔmɛtɔ finɛ angwɛnɛ litina ko l’eoka ya baenyeli ba bindo kongo,
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

lokele: ani atiwateme la Botö ako Masiya oyatokondesa bindo bitotina, ebisoonjakelakana la baonge la betata l’ebitokonda la likondesi lia Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

lokele: Eya to mbo osowa amamwito la Masiya, nda loasɔ loa belimo ya boyalaäla ya wenda-bo, monito otoyalaka imɔ nda njasɔ ya wenda, ndolitesa baiti ba wao,
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

lokele: bako-Oundëke, la olɛtɛ̈kɛ, la omatëke?
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

lokele: Yeka bina ebiongomu bitɔɔlɔ ani bisolomo, la ndola la baiti yende ko eya bato kongo.
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

lokele: Baiti ba bɔfɔnɔ-bo basotangomo la bato bamɔi mbo wɛlï wokakalesa, wotefokola, wokilaka yɛmɛ ya bindo, kongo ko bati ango la litina liokufesa ifoifoi sha bindo.
english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

lokele: Eya to mbo osotɛmɔlɔmɔ amamwito la Masiya, fumbaka ndolukaka njasɔ ya Use, olo ayali Masiya nda kɛ̈ka nda osamba w’olome wa Mungu.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

lokele: Takelaka njasɔ ya use bolenda, inga to yao ebile ono se!
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

lokele: Eoka osowela yao, la kwani liwawi lianu lisoisama la Masiya ko ende Mungu.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

lokele: Nde akɛnɛlɛkɛ Masiya oyale liwawi liasu, limɔ ino bolɛnɛkɛ lande nda tala. Beimo eoka ya yɛmɛ ya bindo la liya lia bɛɛnda
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

lokele: Eokao singesaka yɛmɛ ibe ebile nda bindo yanu ya ono se, biko bolëfë la njasɔ ya bɔwɛwɛ la ifoifoi la yɛmɛ yasi ibe, la bolole ebole lisemoli lia bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu;
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

lokele: ko l’eoka ya njasɔ-bi efango ya Mungu esoyela bana ba totefola,
english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

lokele: la ino imɔ wakelaka yao oso ani ayaelak’ino sisi ya bɔfɔnɔ ona.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

lokele: Nde kwani sokolaka bitotina-bi ya ekanda-ye, biko bolengi la efango, la lisiela la limɔli la baoi ba boendu, angokusw’imɔ nda bɛnɔkɔ yanu.
english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

lokele: Otakanëke nanga ani ino kosokola imɔ boyaeli wa oso la bekeeli ya oso kwa boto oyatosokola bisinda,
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

lokele: la wataka boyaeli boyai ebosotonjomo la wɛlï ko la boyaeli wa Mungu oyakelaka wao;
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

lokele: nde nda wao, angwɛnɛ imɔ WaHela la WaYuda, ango ewa itombe kwa ewa losunga, ango bɔɛnda, bosenji wa Sukutiya, ango bɔkɔwa ango iote, kangä Masiya ende yaatotina la awachani la yaatotina. Bakakanelo ba njasɔ yotutelomo l’eba Masiya
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

lokele: Eokao, ino ebasoaomo, ebüchomu, ebasamomu ba Mungu, wataka botema wa shota la ngandi la liikami se, la botema sambo, la limɛsɛkɛlɛni,
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

lokele: la lisambolani ko la losamɔ; la boto eyala la wina la loasɔ lɔmɔi, ino ko mɛsɛkɛlenɛ kwa Ngɛnɛ asomɛsɛkelɛ imɔ ko ino.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

lokele: Simbi to taliaka likolo lia bitotina-bi ko losamɔ eoka loao lole ngo bɔkɔli bokandaka yao hɔlɔɔ.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

lokele: La lilatemi lia Masiya liyaleke bokomyi wa betema yanu, eoka osotomo lioi ongoma mbo oyaleke bindo ɛmwito. Yalakaka imɔ la kelekele.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

lokele: Lioi lia Masiya liyaleke la lifotesi sisi yanu, ekesanaka la imakanaka la wɛlï bototina, ko la bɛɛlɛ la ngambi la yuwelo ya Bolimo, la kelekele ende Mungu nda betema yanu.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

lokele: La baölo batotina ebatoong’ino la bekeeli bitotina yanu, bikelomoko ngo ko nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu, l’ani atofaekefa ino Mungu Sango kelekele ko l’eoka yande ako Yesu. Beimo ende bali la batolome, bana la basango, bɛkɔwa la bangɛnɛ
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

lokele: Ino bali, litesaka balome banu kwa aondu nde l’eba Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

lokele: Ino batolome, samaka bali banu, oyalëke la loanga end’iyo.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

lokele: Ino bana, litesaka ebaot’ino nda njasɔ bitotina, eoka engani nde ongoma l’eba Ngɛnɛ.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

lokele: Basango, ofɔɔlɛ̈kɛ bana banu mbo batoka likati.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

lokele: Ino bɛkɔwa, litesaka bangɛnɛ banu ebale bato, nda njasɔ bitotina, inga to kwa toambacha ko l’eoka basotichak’ino, kangä la botema bototina, l’ani asowangak’ino Ngɛnɛ.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

lokele: Bakuwa ebakakelek’ino, kelaka bao ko la botema bolau kwa mbo okuweli nde Ngɛnɛ wasu, inga bato kongo;
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

lokele: osoluwa to mbo otɔɔlɔ botiko wande kwa bosömbo wengani, wende bɛkɔwa nda likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ ako Masiya.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

lokele: Ebatokelaka obe kokambomo imɔ bobe ebosokel’iyo, angokwelakwela bɔmbɔ wa boto.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

lokele: Ino bangɛnɛ, keelaka bɛkɔwa yanu la liengani la olau, osoluwa to mbo ino imɔ wende la Ngɛnɛ nda Use. Bakakanelo loasɔ loa lisomboli la bofiili
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

lokele: Sombokolaka la bofiili, lambakaka la botengu imɔ amamwito la kelekele ende Mungu,
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

lokele: somboelak’imɔ ko iso mbo Mungu alioelek’iso bome wa linangoli lia lioi lia ebisoisolomo ya Masiya, oyakandelomu’mi bɔnyɔlɔlɔ,
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

lokele: mbo isanoleke yao fololo kwa engani nde lami ndoonga.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

lokele: Yalakaka la boyaeli wa wɛlï ende ebati b’Etanda, wetesëke fofe yoluwesa basi Mboli Ilau;
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

lokele: la baoi banu bayalakeke mbile bitotina la bootaota, la loendo kwa loao loa bokwa nda bieka, mbo oluweke ndomutoela boto la boto la lioi lioengana lande. Mboli la baseeli ba beoto ya Paulo
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

lokele: Tukiko, etungani oyasamomu lasu, atoluwes’ino njasɔ yami bitotina; ale bosungi wa lotimbana la bokuwani lami nda likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ wasu;
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

lokele: la isotom’inde end’ino ko la litina-li, mbo oluweke ani ayali njasɔ yasu, la mbo afumbeseke betema yanu.
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

lokele: Amamwito lande, isotoma imɔ Onesimo etungani oyasamomu lasu la oyale la lotimbana, ale ɔmɔi wanu angɛnɛ; beluwesak’ino njasɔ bitotina ebisokelomo ono.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

lokele: Alisitaluka oyale amamwito lami nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, asoseel’ino la Malako imɔ ako wana wa tata ya Balanaba; wafomoko bakakanelo loasɔ loande, eya end’ino, ino konyangel’inde eyanu.
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

lokele: Yoswa imɔ oyatangomu Yuseto asoseel’ino; ebato-ba kongo, ba ebatenyi itombe basungani nde lami nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu la basosucha’mi la lisungi liau.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

lokele: Ɔmɔi wanu angɛnɛ ako Epafula, asoseel’ino, ale bɔkɔwa wa Masiya Yesu la atosombokoel’ino la bonui mbo okɔkɔmɛkɛ kɔkɛ ndokɔchaka lisangi litotina lia Mungu.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

lokele: Isoaola la wewe oso wanu mbo asokuwel’ino la bonui finɛ, la eoka ya eba Laodikiya la Hiyelopoli lisanga.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

lokele: Luka, bonganga bosamomu lasu asoseel’ino, la Dema imɔ ko ongoma.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

lokele: Seelaka bitungani bitotina nda bokenge wa Laodikiya, la Numfa l’eba Etanda ebatosɔngɔkɔmɔ omolo nda ndakɔ yande.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

lokele: Akatangomoko lokasa-lo end’ino, kɛsɛkɛ loao ende Etanda nda Laodikiya mbo batangek’imɔ ko loao, la ɔsɔkɔ imɔ ko eloa Laodikiya mbo ino otangeke loao.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

lokele: La ongaka la Alikipo mbo— Tichaka to likuwa elisofomo aɛ eoka ya Ngɛnɛ wasu, mbo ɔlɔlɛkɛ liao la wɛlï.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

lokele: Liseeli-li lile ko la bosamba wami angɛnɛ ako Paulo, enyakelaka mbo ikandomu nde bɔnyɔlɔlɔ. Booto boyaleke lanu!
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
